svg.title: Diagram: The three trust boundaries of remote agent dispatch
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram showing three architectural boundaries from left to right: 1. Mobile Boundary (Phone Chat UI) with speech icon; 2. Desktop Boundary (Local Daemon) with robot icon and hatch fill; 3. Enterprise Boundary (ERP and CRM) with database icon. Below each boundary, a note card details the oversight gap, ambient authority, and transaction risk.

text.tspan: how oversight separates between mobile chat and enterprise databases
Friction removed at the chat UI does not disappear — it transfers to the database.
Based on documented WorkBuddy & MCP specifications — architectural desk audit.
